body:
I smoke [Tahoe OG marijuana] everydayscripts for everythingcurrent mental conditions, PTSD, SAD, panic disorder, GAD.  History of substance abuse and attempted suicide. [I take] the black capsules (Maeng Da 50:1 extract) once daily on empty stomach with 16-32oz water.  Controls pain better than a 30mg oxycodone and lasts 24 hrs.  I NEVER take more than 2 consecutive days or bad things happen.  OD leads to massive anxiety, uncontrollable with benzosonly controlled with low dose alcohol (light beer).
While peaking on a black capsule (+45 min into experience) I consistently (more than 10 times over last 4 months) drink more water and never have a hangover effect.  My only effects are the ones I desire deep sedation (visibly fadedno condition to drive), no anxiety, elevated mood, muscle relaxation, HUGE increase in ability to concentrate and complete tasks.  Major increase in motivation.  No appetite.
